question: Which of the following festivals is mainly related to Manipur?
solution:
**Solution:**

The correct answer is **option 1 - Youshang.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

**__Key Points __**

__
 
• ** Youshang** is the main festival celebrated in **Manipur**.
 
• It is a harvest festival and is celebrated in October.
 
• The festival is also known as Ningol Chakouba and is celebrated to strengthen the bond between brothers and sisters.
 
• During the festival, sisters invite their brothers to their homes and prepare traditional dishes for them.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Manipur is a state in** Northeast India**, bordered by Nagaland to the north, Mizoram to the south, and Assam to the west.
 
• Manipur is known for its rich culture and traditions, and is also called the **"Jewel of India"**.
 
• **Youshang** is one of the most important festivals celebrated in Manipur and is a major tourist attraction.
 
• The festival is celebrated with great enthusiasm and includes various cultural programs and sports events.
